settings.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?

writeOnly.set: A value is saved. Leave blank to keep it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Let your people sign in with their company account (single sign-on).

provider.title: Identity provider
provider.googleHint: Client ID and secret from your Google Cloud project.
provider.microsoftHint: Tenant ID, client ID and secret from your app registration.
provider.oidcHint: Okta, Auth0, Keycloak or any OpenID Connect provider.

signIn.tenantIdHint: The directory (tenant) ID, a GUID. The generic values common and organizations are not accepted.
signIn.issuerHint: The address of your provider, for example https://login.example.com.
signIn.scopesHint: Space separated. Leave empty for the default: openid email profile.

domains.title: Allowed email domains
domains.label: Email domains
domains.hint: People with an email at these domains see the single sign-on button on the sign-in page. Your own email domain must be listed to test.

redirect.title: Redirect URL
redirect.help: Paste this into your identity provider as the authorized redirect (callback) URL.
redirect.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.

enable.label: Enable single sign-on
enable.hint: People at your listed domains can sign in with the provider.
enable.saveFirst: Save your changes, then run a test sign-in.
enable.needsTest: Run a successful test sign-in before enabling.

required.label: Require single sign-on
required.hint: Everyone except organization admins must sign in through the provider.
required.warning: Warning: non-admin users will no longer be able to sign in with a password. Organization admins keep password sign-in as the emergency way in.

test.explain: The test signs you in through the provider with your own account. It does not change your session.
test.needsSave: Save your provider settings to enable the test.
test.saveFirst: Save your changes to enable the test.
test.ok: Test sign-in succeeded. Single sign-on is verified and can be enabled.
test.failed: Test sign-in failed. Check the client ID, secret, redirect URL and that your own account can sign in, then try again.
test.domainNotListed: Your own email domain must be in the allowed domains list (and saved) before you can test.
test.notConfigured: The provider could not be reached with the saved settings. Check them and save again.

remove.title: Remove single sign-on?
remove.body: This deletes the provider settings, the allowed domains and the linked identities. People will sign in with their passwords again.

error.notVerified: Run a successful test sign-in before enabling or requiring single sign-on.

fieldError.domain_taken: {{value}} is already used by another organization.
fieldError.admin_domain_not_listed: Your own email domain must be listed.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account and your organization's basic details.
profile.name: Name
profile.orgHint: Dates throughout the app are shown in this timezone.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Sign-in rules for everyone in your organization.
security.domainsHint: One domain per line, for example company.com. Leave empty to turn Google sign-in off.
security.historyHint: A new password cannot match this many recent ones.
security.totp: Require an authenticator app for admins
security.totpHint: Admins are asked to set one up. It is not enforced at sign-in yet.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.subtitle: How long candidate personal data is kept.
retention.hint: Between 7 and 730 days. Scores and decisions stay for reporting after personal data is removed.

invites.title: Invites
invites.subtitle: Defaults for new candidate invites.
invites.hint: Applies to new invites. HR can extend an individual invite later.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: Send invites by email through your own mail server.
email.testFail: The test email could not be sent: {{reason}}

ai.title: AI setup
ai.subtitle: Connect your own AI provider for question suggestions and scoring.

documents.title: Documents
documents.subtitle: Privacy notices, terms and the consent statement candidates agree to.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.body: Create a consent statement so candidates can agree before their exam.

documents.noVersions: No versions yet. Write the first one.
documents.pdfHint: A PDF replaces the written text for this version.
documents.publishBody: A published version never changes again. Candidates see the newest published version.

branding.title: Branding
branding.subtitle: Colors, font, themes and logo shown to your team and candidates. Themes apply to the whole organization (all HR users and candidates).
branding.legacyFound: Found theme settings saved only in this browser: save to make them organization-wide.
branding.combosHint: Pick a ready-made set. It fills the primary, accent, page, text and navigation colors below, and you can still change each one.
branding.typeNotSupported: {{type}} is not supported here. Please use one of: {{supported}}.
branding.resetBody: Colors, font and images go back to the platform default.
